name: voltra-techtonics-monorepo
description: VOLTRA AI-Powered Grid Intelligence — Techtonics Bobathon submission. Cinematic landing + React dashboard.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "LANDING,APP" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix \"bob frontend\"" "npm run dev --prefix src/frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix "bob frontend" && cd src/frontend && bun install
scripts.build: npm run build:landing && npm run build:app
